sub: The organisation, languages, the support letter, what the public site shows, and your own account.
help_sub: Shown on the public site and in letters.
default_lang_sub: Each person can switch at the top; their choice is remembered.
digits_sub: In Kurdish, show numbers as ١٢٣ instead of 123.
sample_sub: Shows "Sample data" in the top bar until the database is connected.
letter_sub: The name and title printed under every support letter for a farmer.
prefix_sub: 2 to 6 capital letters or digits. Example: {ex}
public_sub: What anyone can see without signing in.
pv_map_sub: Districts coloured by dryness, with details.
pv_compare_sub: Dryness this year against other years.
pv_farmTotals_sub: Number of farmers, farms and land per district. Never names or phones.
password_note: Passwords are handled by Supabase once it is connected: use "Forgot your password?" on the sign-in page to choose a new one.
reset_sub: Throws away every change made in this browser (farmers, farms, texts, settings) and loads the sample data again.
reset_confirm: All changes made in this browser are lost. This cannot be undone.
